title: Let holy company lift Maya's dust
summary: Love for the Guru and holy company clear Maya's dust. Move toward the company that steadies the heart.
takeaway: Move toward the company that steadies the heart.
lifeApplication: Before starting one more private search, step into sangat, kirtan, or one truthful conversation.

source.shortMeaning: Love for the Guru and holy company clear Maya's dust.
